verdict.rationale: Bench is a human-plus-software bookkeeping SaaS, a kind of product that could plausibly publish an API and official SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only end-user features such as account connections, categorization, reporting and banking, and never mentions an SDK or developer API. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
